title: Require Recipe Step Config Owner Shape
forbids: recipe step config.ts modules without one canonical config = defineStep(...) contract, with additional runtime exports or re-exports, with a literal step id different from the immediate directory, or with a default export
why: A recipe step has one local filesystem and public runtime identity expressed by its literal config contract. Local helpers and erased type/interface exports remain available without creating competing exported runtime surfaces. Exact config.ts acquisition selects the kind; the filename capture exists only to prove directory/id equality. Core's defineStep contract owns constructor admission, while Knip owns unused private construction.
remediate: Make the kebab-case step directory equal the literal defineStep id, retain one documented config = defineStep(...) export, keep non-authority helpers local, and delete default or additional runtime exports and re-exports.
message: Recipe step config.ts must expose only its canonical local config contract.
